intent: Audit the exact frozen task-label comparison, candidate integrity and calibration references before model execution.
scope: Preparation and refinement integrity. Calibration execution, generated-output quality and behavior acceptance remain unassessed.

independent_checks.frozen_sources: snapshot() verified every pinned current source SHA-256 and fingerprint.
independent_checks.label_only_change: Reverse substitution recovers each current system request exactly; original heading and component payload remain intact, including the duplicate progress inventory in room requests.
independent_checks.sequence_only_addition: Each sequence system request equals its label-only request plus the exact candidate-sequence.txt text.
independent_checks.target_input_isolation: All non-system messages are identical across the three main arms. Evaluator reference data is supplied separately to the judge.
independent_checks.production_reference_requests: All 66 requests match the immutable initial baseline's same case and repetition exactly; they are a separate historical-production reference, not the current dirty branch baseline.
independent_checks.completion_pair: Both members share explicit learner-owned observation and meaning plus the same action question. Only the final learner answer changes. The completed member contains a meaningful private-coordination action; the incomplete member remains a bare risk verdict.
independent_checks.case_scope: 22 inherited ordinary cases reused; five protection/contextual-protection cases excluded with trace. Both original trajectories retained. Added one real room record and a synthetic completion pair. No eligible holdout claim.

findings.original: The first calibration draft marked an audience question as useful next work after the learner had already identified strangers as the audience.
findings.resolution: Version 2 uses an unmet timing observation: whether the outing has happened yet. The prior draft freeze remains preserved.

findings.original: Nintendo calibration contexts retained another participant's unresolved click intention even though the new comparison is scoped to ordinary teaching.
findings.resolution: Version 2 omits those four calibration checks. The original records remain preserved, and target-case exclusions record the contextual-protection reason.

findings.evidence: The candidate states general learner-evidence, component-order, continuation and reopening rules traceable to T01.1/T02.1/T02.2. It contains no case identifiers, expected-label lookup, example-specific exceptions or scenario names.

Single-metric judgments preserve the three distinct properties and use reason/evidence before pass. Calibration includes permitted action disclosure after explicit confusion, retained earlier action attempts, premature disclosure, target switching, completed-task advance and redundant retesting.
findings.condition: The versioned calibration must pass before comparison. Its references are independent AI-reviewed annotations, not human-gold labels; passing them does not rule out output-level grading defects.

limits: This independent audit supports integrity, not measured generalization or behavior acceptance.
Existing production-baseline coverage is limited to the inherited fixed cases, so its totals cannot be directly compared with the larger main-arm totals.
Trajectory histories diverge by actual generated tutor replies; later turns are controlled journey comparisons, not identical-input pairs.
Checklist state stays frozen. The experiment cannot establish analyzer correctness or human learning gains.
Full regression, eligible unseen holdout and release verification remain outside this focused run.
